summary: koa.com booking step 2 behind Cloudflare verification (unread); park pages read from 2025-2026 Wayback captures; Google read. GOOGLE 3.8 over 308 reviews = automatic DROP CANDIDATE (under 4.0 with 25+). Stored $100-127 not re-confirmed; price gate lifted anyway by gateway Lake Tahoe (South) 11 km. Year-round, 30-amp max, 65-ft max, full and partial hookups, laundry/store/showers/wifi. Echo Creek along the south edge (2024 site map: sites 150-163, 354-363) - possible creekside, unconfirmable under canopy; left not waterfront. Phone and website unchanged.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (Google): Google Maps panel 'Lake Tahoe KOA Journey' 3.8 over 308 reviews (read 2026-11-27) - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews is the automatic drop. Review themes on koa.com: 'Small, cramped sites and noisy highway', 'a little tight for class A motorhome'.

PRICE: koa.com's step 2 returned Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' every time (not solved or worked around), so the stored $100-127 (koa.com, 2027-05-18, read 2026-10-19) is unconfirmed and no cheaper shoulder night could be looked for. Price gate: over US$50, but gateways.py finds 'Lake Tahoe (South)' at 11 km, so the gate is lifted; no Good Sam check needed for that reason.

WATERFRONT (possible creekside, not proposed): koa.com says the park sits 'alongside Echo Creek' and lists 'Creek' as an amenity; a reviewer 'had a spot near the creek'; the 2024 Guest Services Guide map ('CAMPSITES NOT DRAWN TO SCALE') draws Echo Creek along the south edge against sites 150-157 (no hookups), 158-163 and 354-363. Imagery is solid pine canopy and the creek is not legible, so distance can't be measured; per the canopy rule this stays not waterfront unless AWH confirms. Candidate pads: the south row (around 38.8448,-120.0296, where 3DEP shows a 4-6 m low that may be the channel).
LONG-STAY tests: a KOA Journey selling RV nights online year-round; an 'Extended Stays' option exists but nightly booking is the norm - passes.
SITE GUARANTEE: a specific site costs $50 extra per reservation (optional; not in the nightly rate).
PHONE 530-577-3693 and WEBSITE https://koa.com/campgrounds/lake-tahoe/ unchanged (Google panel and koa.com agree). Pin 38.84594,-120.02884 vs KOA's posted 38.845986,-120.029284: ~40 m, fine.
